claim: De Librije location, owners, star history (1 star 1993–1998, 2 stars 1999–2003, 3 stars 2004–present), Spinhuisplein 1 Zwolle, head chef Nelson Tanate.
quote: One star: 1993–1998. Two stars: 1999–2003. Three stars: 2004–present. Owners: Thérèse Boer-Tausch & Family. Head Chef: Nelson Tanate. Spinhuisplein 1, Zwolle. Formerly located in the old library of a 15th-century Dominican abbey; in 2015, relocated to a new location.

claim: October 2025 Michelin Guide ceremony in Maastricht; De Librije retained 3 stars; Jonnie Boer received posthumous Mentorship Award after April 2025 death; NL has 98×1★, 20×2★, 1×3★.
quote: De Librije in Zwolle retained its three Michelin stars. The head chef and co-owner of the restaurant, Jonnie Boer, passed away in April and was honoured posthumously with a Mentorship Award. The 2025 guide includes 98 one-star restaurants, 20 two-star restaurants and one three-star restaurant.

claim: October 6, 2025 Michelin ceremony outcome: De Librije keeps 3 stars, two new 2-star awards in NL.
quote: Seven more Dutch Michelin star winners include two new 2-star spots; De Librije keeps 3.

claim: December 2025 independent review: De Librije maintains 3-star standard post-Jonnie-Boer; 8-course €319 (veg €299); premium wine pairing €335; signature foie gras with Dutch shrimp.
quote: Eight-course fixed menu at €319 (vegetarian €299), with premium wine pairing at €335. Twenty years on, the magic remains. Service is a masterclass in hospitality. Chef Nelson Tanate maintained consistency.

claim: De Librije address, phone, green star since 2021, three Michelin stars since 2004.
quote: Spinhuisplein 1, 8011 ZZ Zwolle. +31 (0) 38 853 00 00. Three Michelin stars (held continuously since 2004). Green star for sustainable gastronomy (awarded 2021).

claim: De Librije dining concept: 10-course De Librije menu or custom 5–7 course; converted former prison setting; courtyard under glass roof; 19-room hotel attached.
quote: Guests can choose either the De Librije menu featuring 10 dishes or compose custom menus with 5–7 dishes from four categories. The dining area occupies the former prison courtyard under an impressive glass roof. The property features 19 luxury hotel rooms.

claim: Sister restaurant Librije's Zusje closed Dec 31 2014 in Zwolle; held 2 stars 2012–2014; later opened in Amsterdam at Waldorf Astoria.
quote: Opened: 2008. Closed: December 31, 2014. Final Michelin rating: 2 stars (held 2012-2014). Amsterdam Expansion: Opened May 1, 2014 at the Waldorf Astoria Hotel.

claim: De Lindenhof Giethoorn tasting menus: 4-course Lindenhofmenu €170, 8-course Martins Ziel & Zaligheid €210, 12-course Chefs Parade €250.
quote: Lindenhofmenu — 4 courses — €170. Martins Ziel & Zaligheid — 8 courses — €210. Chefs Parade — 12 courses — €250.

claim: De Lindenhof in Giethoorn, chef Martin Kruithof, second Michelin star awarded 2005.
quote: Chef-owner Martin Kruithof previously worked as a cook in the German three-star restaurant Im Schiffchen in Düsseldorf. In 2005 the restaurant was awarded a second Michelin star.

claim: 't Nonnetje Harderwijk tasting menus: Michel's Meesterkok 4/5/6 courses €147.50/€167.50/€187.50; Botanica vegetarian 4–7 courses €132.50–€182.50; Verleiding lunch 2–3 courses €55–€75.
quote: Michel's Meesterkok Menu: 4 courses €147.50, 5 courses €167.50, 6 courses €187.50. Menu Botanica (vegetarian): 4 courses €132.50, 5 courses €152.50, 6 courses €172.50, 7 courses €182.50. Menu de Verleiding lunch 2 courses €55, 3 courses €65.

claim: 't Nonnetje on Vischmarkt Harderwijk; chef Michel van der Kroft since 2006; second Michelin star awarded 2015; Portuguese influence.
quote: Located in a beautiful monumental fisherman's house on the historic Vischmarkt of Harderwijk. In 2015 the restaurant was awarded its second Michelin star. Chef Michel van der Kroft draws a lot of inspiration from Portugal.

claim: De Groene Lantaarn address Gemeenteweg 364, Staphorst; chef Jarno Eggen; two Michelin stars.
quote: Gemeenteweg 364, 7951 PG Staphorst, Netherlands. Chef Jarno Eggen. Two Michelin stars. Thursday-Friday: Lunch (until 14:00), Dinner (from 18:00); Saturday: Dinner only; Sunday: Lunch and Dinner.

claim: De Groene Lantaarn closes permanently May 3, 2026; ranked #4 in Lekker500 edition 2026; Eggen and Borger going separate ways.
quote: Toprestaurant De Groene Lantaarn, nummer 4 in Lekker500 editie 2026, sluit deuren. The restaurant is closing as of May 3, 2026. Eggen and Borger are going their separate ways.

claim: De Groene Lantaarn opened 2009 in Zuidwolde; relocated to Staphorst after 10 years; two Michelin stars since 2016.
quote: De Groene Lantaarn opened in 2009 in Zuidwolde and after ten years relocated to its current location in Staphorst. The restaurant has held two Michelin stars since 2016.

claim: Michelin Netherlands 2025 overview: De Librije is the sole 3-star; 20 two-star restaurants nationwide; ceremony held in Maastricht.
quote: De Librije in Zwolle has managed to hold onto its three Michelin stars. The Michelin Guide for the Netherlands in 2025 includes 98 one-star restaurants, 20 two-star restaurants and one three-star restaurant.

claim: Official Michelin Guide page for De Librije, Zwolle — Three Stars, modern cuisine, Spinhuisplein 1.
quote: De Librije – Zwolle: Three MICHELIN Stars. Modern Cuisine. Spinhuisplein 1, 8011 ZZ Zwolle. Iconic — Worth Queueing For.

claim: Official Michelin Guide listing for Zwolle restaurants — no 2-star, one 3-star (De Librije).
quote: Zwolle MICHELIN Restaurants — The MICHELIN Guide Netherlands. De Librije (3 stars), Restaurant Affect (1 star), NOÏS, Brass Boer Thuis.
